_说明: 多项目监控配置（schema v2）。每个项目独立关键词 + subreddit，一次运行全部扫完。新增项目直接复制一段。每天每 sub 扫 2 页，成本约 12 credits/项目/天。

_schema.projects[].name: str, 唯一项目名
_schema.projects[].pain_words: list[str], reserved / unused in rule_v3（v3 打分只用模块常量 PAIN_WORDS）
_schema.projects[].demand_domain: str, 该产品的需求域（可选）。口径来自 data/testset/<id>/meta.json 的 label_judgement_standard：判据(1) 按需求域判定，不是按 SKU 精确匹配。留空则回落为 keywords。

projects.name: Einprag
projects.demand_domain: exam prep / studying / memorization. IN domain: flashcard apps, question banks, workbooks, exam-prep resources, spaced-repetition tools, language-learning apps, study-skills courses, recall-improvement courses. OUT of domain: a different algorithm, an interview tracker, career/residency consulting, and pure method consultation (asking only how long to study, with no resource request).

projects.name: IntentRadar_自举
projects.demand_domain: finding customers / customer acquisition / lead generation / getting users. IN domain: 'find customers', 'be found by customers', 'get users', lead gen, outreach that converts, monitoring communities for buying signals, cold-start acquisition. OUT of domain: landing pages, finding TikTok creators, fundraising intros, interview/residency trackers, generic 'growth' with no ask about reaching buyers.
